visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man in a gray oversized t-shirt enters the frame from the right and stands against a plain, light-brown textured wall. He looks at his arm. (2) He rolls up his left sleeve to his shoulder, revealing his arm. A girl in a light purple shirt enters from the left holding a purple hand-pump device. (3) The girl pumps the device near the man's bicep; the bicep appears to inflate and expand significantly. White 'impact' graphics appear around the arm. Both characters look at the camera and give a thumbs-up. (4) The scene cuts to a small shirtless boy standing in the same position against the wall. The girl uses the same purple pump on the boy's upper arm. (5) As she pumps, the boy's belly suddenly inflates and becomes rounded instead of his arm. Red arrow graphics appear pointing down at his stomach. (6) The girl looks directly at the camera with a wide-eyed, mischievous expression and rolls her eyes upward. A 'rolling eyes' emoji graphic overlays her face. (7) The boy is shown sitting on a bed in yellow pajamas, laughing hysterically with his mouth wide open.
